title: Discovery of new antiviral agents through artificial intelligence: in vitro and in vivo results
abstract: arXiv:2611.22230v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this research, we employed a deep reinforcement learning (RL)-based molecule design platform to generate a diverse set of compounds targeting the neuraminidase (NA) of influenza A and B viruses. A total of 60291 compounds were generated, of which 86.5% displayed superior physicochemical properties compared to oseltamivir. After narrowing down the selection through computational filters, nine compounds with non-sialic acid-like structures were selected for in vitro experiments. We identified two compounds, DS-22-inf-009 and DS-22-inf-021 that effectively inhibited the NAs of both influenza A and B viruses (IAV and IBV), including H275Y mutant strains at low micromolar concentrations. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed a similar pattern of interaction with amino acid residues as oseltamivir. In cell-based assays, DS-22-inf-009 and DS-22-inf-021 inhibited IAV and IBV in a dose-dependent manner with EC50 values ranging from 0.29 uM

translated_title: 通过人工智能发现新型抗病毒药物：体外和体内研究结果
translated_abstract: 在这项研究中，我们采用基于深度强化学习（RL）的分子设计平台，生成了针对甲型和乙型流感病毒神经氨酸酶（NA）的多样化化合物集合。共生成了60291个化合物，其中86.5%的化合物表现出优于奥司他韦的理化性质。经过计算筛选缩小选择范围后，选出九个具有非唾液酸样结构的化合物进行体外实验。我们发现两个化合物DS-22-inf-009和DS-22-inf-021，它们能在低微摩尔浓度下有效抑制甲型和乙型流感病毒（IAV和IBV）的神经氨酸酶，包括H275Y突变株。分子动力学模拟显示它们与氨基酸残基的相互作用模式与奥司他韦相似。在细胞实验中，DS-22-inf-009和DS-22-inf-021以剂量依赖性方式抑制IAV和IBV，EC50值范围为0.29微摩尔。
tldr: 本研究利用深度强化学习分子设计平台生成并筛选化合物，发现了DS-22-inf-009和DS-22-inf-021两个新型非唾液酸样结构的神经氨酸酶抑制剂，可在低微摩尔浓度下有效抑制甲型和乙型流感病毒（包括H275Y耐药突变株）。
en_tdlr: This study used a deep reinforcement learning-based molecular design platform to discover two novel non-sialic acid-like neuraminidase inhibitors, DS-22-inf-009 and DS-22-inf-021, which effectively inhibit both influenza A and B viruses, including H275Y mutant strains, at low micromolar concentrations.
